paper_metadata.title: Shikra: Unleashing Multimodal LLM's Referential Dialogue Magic
paper_metadata.abstract: In human conversations, individuals can indicate relevant regions within a scene while addressing others. In turn, the other person can then respond by referring to specific regions if necessary. This natural referential ability in dialogue remains absent in current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). To fill this gap, this paper proposes an MLLM called Shikra, which can handle spatial coordinate inputs and outputs in natural language. Its architecture consists of a vision encoder, an alignment layer, and a LLM. It is designed to be straightforward and simple, without the need for extra vocabularies, position encoder, pre-/post-detection modules, or external plug-in models. All inputs and outputs are in natural language form. Referential dialogue is a superset of various vision-language (VL) tasks. Shikra can naturally handle location-related tasks like REC and PointQA, as well as conventional VL tasks such as Image Captioning and VQA. Experimental results showcase Shikra's promising performance. Furthermore, it enables numerous exciting applications, like providing mentioned objects' coordinates in chains of thoughts and comparing user-pointed regions similarities. Our code, model and dataset are accessed at https://github.com/shikras/shikra.

extraction_data.innovation: Formulates spatial position input/output as natural language coordinates instead of extra coordinate vocabularies; eliminates need for pre-/post-detectors or special position encoders; leverages GPT-4 to generate high-quality referential dialogue data with positional annotations.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Multimodal alignment and referential dialogue generation
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: RefCOCO, Visual Genome, Visual-7W, Flickr30K Entities, LLaVA-Instruct-150K, GPT-4 synthesized RD data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised instruction tuning on meticulously collected instruction data, Supervised fine-tuning for vision-language tasks, referential dialogue, and grounding
extraction_data.extension: Fine-tuning a multimodal LLM to support referential dialogue with point/box grounding.
extraction_data.research_problem: Referential dialogue and spatial position understanding in multimodal LLMs
extraction_data.application: Referential dialogue, visual question answering, image captioning, referring expression comprehension, grounding
extraction_data.paper_title: Shikra: Unleashing Multimodal LLM's Referential Dialogue Magic
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Flickr30K Entities, GPT-4 generated Q&A pairs
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Separate pre-training of ViT and LLM, followed by fine-tuning with a fully connected alignment layer and full LLM parameters
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Fully connected layer for modal alignment; visual embeddings inserted into LLM input sequence
